# Bio-protocol Journal

> > An open-access, peer-reviewed journal publishing detailed life science research protocols across multiple disciplines with community-driven protocol sharing and preprint capabilities.

Bio-protocol is a comprehensive platform for publishing, discovering, and sharing standardized research protocols across biochemistry, cell biology, molecular biology, immunology, neuroscience, and other life science domains. The journal emphasizes reproducibility, open access, and collaborative protocol development through its integrated preprint repository, webinar series, and community exchange features.

## Core Journal

- [Bio-protocol Journal Homepage](https://bio-protocol.org/en): Bio-protocol homepage: open-access peer-reviewed life science protocols
- [Bio-protocol Journal | Bio-protocol](https://en.bio-protocol.org/category.aspx): Bio-protocol peer-reviewed, open-access journal for life science protocols
- [About Us](https://bio-protocol.org/en/about): Bio-protocol journal mission, vision, and organizational information
- [eBook Resource Collection](https://en.bio-protocol.org/ebookinfo.aspx): Bio-protocol eBook resource for curated life science research protocols

## Protocol Submission & Publishing

- [Submission Procedure](https://bio-protocol.org/en/authors): Author guidelines and protocol submission procedures for Bio-protocol
- [Presubmission Inquiry Service](https://bio-protocol.org/en/psi): Presubmission inquiry service for protocol publication guidance
- [FAQ -- Bio-protocol Journal](https://bio-protocol.org/en/faqs): FAQs on submission, peer review, publication criteria, and guidelines
- [Bio-protocol Preprint Repository](https://bio-protocol.org/exchange/bppreprint): Preprint repository for sharing life science protocols before peer review

## Community & Peer Review

- [Join the Bio-protocol Reviewer Board](https://bio-protocol.org/en/becomereviewer): Peer review board recruitment and reviewer application information
- [Request a Protocol (RaP)](https://bio-protocol.org/exchange/rap-new): Protocol request platform for collaborative research method sharing

## Learning & Resources

- [Bio-protocol Webinars](https://bio-protocol.org/webinar): Free webinar series on cutting-edge life sciences tools and technologies
- [Bio-101 Platform](https://cn.bio-protocol.org/bio101/default.aspx): Bio-101 Chinese-language protocol sharing platform for life sciences
- [News & Announcements](https://bio-protocol.org/en/news): Bio-protocol news, announcements, and journal partnership updates

## User Account & Engagement

- [My Bio Page](https://en.bio-protocol.org/userhome.aspx): User profile and account management for Bio-protocol members
